name: scopekeeper
description: Audit global Claude Code installs against real usage, turn them into per-project cc-* kits, and keep your global setup lean.

staleDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleDays.description: A kit enabled in a project and unused for this many days (since its last use, or since it was enabled) is flagged stale, and Prune offers to remove it.

shellRc.title: Shell rc file
shellRc.description: Where the line that loads the cc-* functions goes. Empty: picked from $SHELL: ~/.zshrc for zsh, otherwise ~/.bashrc plus the bash login file (~/.bash_profile on macOS) when it does not load ~/.bashrc.
